reviews.title: Effective and reliable
reviews.text:
as someone with adhd i have a BAD habit of sleeping straight through my alarms, turning them off in my sleep, waking up late with no memory of ever turning them off, and my alarms becoming background music for my dreams, etc. this is the only app that has really truly worked for me. I tried a competitor app but it was stupid expensive and sometimes unreliable. ive been using this app for maybe 6 months and have had great luck with my alarms always going off on time. the apple alarms are such a gamble (and way too easy to disable) so it brings me a lot of comfort to know i have something to rely on. the “loud” section alarms are insanely obnoxious and INCREDIBLY effective. they are absolutely ear assaulting and nearly impossible to sleep through which is great. i like to set my first couple alarms with the “peaceful” sounds and the last few as the “loud” ones. 

The ONLY THING i would change about this app is the ability to sort the alarms by time. They sort by recently added/edited which makes it hard to find the ones im looking for sometimes. I would be elated if the creators could add that function. 

Overall, the price is super reasonable and SO WORTH IT. I am not usually one to spend money on apps but this one is definitely worth the purchase if you are a heavy sleeper!

Literally worse than the built in apple alarm clock. Not worth the money
